title: InstructionTrustPolicy
description: One instruction trust policy file, as written.

blocklist.description: File digests refused whoever signed them.

enforcement.description: `deny` (the default when a policy exists), `warn`, or `audit`.

includes.description: Globs selecting instruction files, relative to each scanned root. Omitted means the built-in list; an empty list selects nothing.

publishers.description: Who may sign an instruction file.

BlockedDigest.description: A file digest refused regardless of who signed it.

reason.description: Why it is blocked; shown when a file is refused.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file, as 64 hex characters, optionally `sha256:`-prefixed.

Enforcement.description:
What a failed verification does to the boot.

Ordered by strictness, so "the stricter of two" is `max`.

oneOf.description: Record each verdict in the audit chain and say nothing.
Print each failure and boot anyway; still recorded.
Refuse the boot if any instruction file fails verification.

Publisher.description: A publisher whose signature makes an instruction file trusted.

oneOf.description:
A CI workflow signing keylessly through Sigstore.

The signing certificate names the workflow file bound to the ref it ran under; `repository` and `workflow` must match exactly, `ref` is a glob.

name.description: Unique name, used in reports and audit entries.

ref.description: Glob over the git ref the workflow ran under, e.g. `refs/heads/main` or `refs/tags/v*`. `*` does not cross `/`; use `**` for that.

oneOf.description: An Ed25519 key, named by exactly one of `key_id` or `public_key`.

key_id.description: A key enrolled with `mvmctl trust add` (32 lowercase hex).

name.description: Unique name, used in reports and audit entries.

public_key.description: The 32-byte public key itself, as 64 hex characters.
